title: Stretcher, amplifier stand-in and compressor (analytic)
summary: A 150 fs, 1 nJ sech² pulse at 1030 nm is stretched to 233.6 ps by a grating pair, trimmed by a gain-narrowing filter and recompressed to 268.8 fs, within 0.2 % of the 268.4 fs transform limit of the narrowed spectrum, with 45.38 % of the energy left.
